children: Olas' Pearl Polystrat agents are now indexed with SQD, and the project has completed a full Polygon backfill in one week. The migration replaces Olas' previous indexing stack, which was estimated to need months for the same backfill. Olas operates the largest onchain AI agent economy, and its agent data now runs through SQD's indexing infrastructure.

The speed difference is the concrete result: a workload estimated at months on the old stack finished in one week on SQD. That places SQD inside the AI-agent infrastructure narrative, since agent economies depend on reliable access to onchain data at scale. As the largest onchain AI agent economy, Olas gives SQD a reference deployment that other agent projects can evaluate. Investor attention to SQD as a data layer for agent economies may follow, though the announcement itself covers an integration and backfill result rather than new token mechanics.
Agent economies run 24/7. Their data needs to keep up.
